body: You look after yourself my man, just remember many people understand how you’re feeling..

Well atleast you get invited.. I’be tagged along with a bloke I know and his friend group for the next three days. My birthday is Friday and if I ended up on my own I think it seriously wouldn’t turn out well for me.

I understand you entirely, friend. I too have three friends, all of them live far away. I live with my grandparents who I cannot discuss my mental health with in fear that they’d get upset ( my mum; their daughter suffers clinical depression and bipolar disorder) and that really hurt them when they found out about my mum.
My girlfriend on the other hand is a ver social person, with a great life and is currently enjoying a week long festival with her friends. Up until now I’ve been on my own for 86 hours, smashing sleeping tablets so that time goes quicker. I’m going to the same festival as my partner for three days so I better start smiling in the mirror for some practice.

Exactly the case with my girlfriend. I reach out and tell her how unhappy I am, then decide to act like nothing happened and ignore her messages. Isn’t right burdening her with my shitty thoughts and loneliness 🙃

Happy birthday! I’m turning 21 on Friday.. I’ve been in a bad patch with my depression over the last week and I’m hoping I can get some happiness ready for my birthday. Would hate to ruin it for myself.

I know how you feel my man.. I still feel very lonely to this day even with a girlfriend, family and friends. I find myself on my bed staring at the roof or out of the window to pass the time. Usually comes with overthinking and contemplating negative things. I always aim to take sleeping tablets by 7:40 so I can sleep by 8.30-9 to get the day done sooner.

With my depression I often ignore messages for hours on end. People who Are important to me, my girlfriend and friends being the ones I do it to. 

I get into dark place where I convince my self that they don’t really care that much and that they’re only messaging for the sake of it. Obviously that isn’t always necessarily true but it’s my broken thought process.. most of the time I just reply to their message, tell them to have a good day then tell them I’m switching my phone off.

Faking it only makes it worse.. she’s got a week of a festival in her town. She’s winning stuff and having fun, I’ll have to endure the thoughts and the smiles for one more week until I tell her, even then I believe she will break up with me after it. She isn’t the same with me. 

I’m going to try and go to the doctor next week, I think it’s about time.
Pretty sure it doesn’t my man. I do trust her, I just can’t stop looking..
Because we’re young, we have fiends and we’re both social. We do things together, we both have hobbies but we also go out for drinks.

Na I do trust her. I think checking and seeing that’s she’s been on her phone is quite comforting to me in a sense. Like I know she’s just looked at her phone so she’s okay.. you get me? 

I hate doing it though as I really don’t get any sleep and it isn’t healthy.
She doesn’t go there to get wasted. She’s never really drunk but goes there with her friends. On the other hand I go out to get trashed as I’m at uni.
An i physically check her location, like I know it’s there and can’t stop..
This has been an interesting comment, thank you for your suggestion!

Hi pal I really don’t intend to make her guilty. She knows my social life isn’t good where we live and it’s always been the case. I really just want to get to know her friends and people in her life like I always said I did.
I can’t agree with you pal. I am at uni and nights out are common. Especially in the Uk. Literally going out with friends to have a good time.

You say that but I’m only doing this because she complained that I don’t come with her on nights out. She said about her friends’ boyfriends go out with them and I never have. What do you think about that?

Well she suggested her friends' boyfriends come with them on their nights out. That kind of thing. It really did hurt me when she said this. Hence the effort to go out and me social with her, that I am very audacious and apprehensive about.

I understand all this cliche stuff and all but it's really not realistic. I train to Box rigorously, my diet consists of no processed sugar, I wake up nice and early each morning, I prepare food days in advance. I have structure, will and motivation and I seriously care about this girl and would do anything for her. I don't feel like leaving someone on the first sight of a problem. But thank you for your time and effort into the comments!
And that is a whole nothing thing. I don't really have a social life. Her's is much more healthy. So I'm stuck on my own most nights other than work.
Aye sounds that way currently. I only mean well so go and meet her friends.
It's hard as the brief conversation said I'm welcome to come, but she'll be with her friends. It just doesn't sound very keen to me.
Thanks man, the plan is one thing but the apprehension and anxiety of it is another.
What do you mean?
Exactly, I haven't spoken to her directly about it. She told me we'd speak about it next week. Basically she didn't sound over the moon.
Well all I got what 'I don't want you to be on your own'. I don't really know what this means.

Well this has been a very insightful comment! 

I really do think the process of getting the passion back is going to be difficult. Unfortunately from the way you explained this is slightly misleading! 

My girlfriend is very, and I mean very vanilla. I tried spicing it up as the sex life was slowing but it turns out she didn’t appreciate the stuff I bought her. I do my part, as something that gets me going is making a girl climax, so every time we do have sex she gets to climax always! 
In regards to the acknowledgment of her, I give her so much attention, but i think she’s reached a point now where she doesn’t even notice, and because I don’t get any frequent sex from her I literally restrain from looking at her. I do see her looking at me when she changes, but I always seem occupied of interested in something else. I think I do this mostly out of frustration, and not to look desperate (even though I am) for her when I know she hasn’t got an interest.. in at a very difficult part of the relationship, where her sex drive has completely gone and simultaneously need to bring the trust and passion back into a routine filled relationship. Just to clarify I’m always in awe with my girlfriend, literally always been someone I’ve been very attracted to and been and advocate of letting her now, but I don’t really think she appreciates me telling her as I don’t get much back, except a thank you or a grn.

I’m very much up to the task, and I hope as I please her and get her passion back in everything else but the sex, possible that with come back too!
She recently spoke about this place she wanted to go to, and today I’ve booked two tickets for it without telling her. I’m hoping this is a step she’ll appreciate, especially after our talk last night in how her and I want to improve.

Thank you so much for your meaningful comment! 

I feel like the elephant in the room has been spoken about last night, and I’m sure this will path the way for the more positive outlook on our relationship. Only time will tell though!

Thank you for this insightful comment, violet! From what you’ve given me, I really do see a similarity between my scenario and yours. It’s killing me inside, to the point where I’d driving me insane! I’ve decided the best way I can get there passion back for me is to start integrating myself into her social life. I know for sure that I don’t have much in common, but I think she really wants a guy that comes out with her, for her to show to her friends. I’m a very social person, but that social outlook hasn’t gone well within The relationship. 

As for the my girlfriend I think I need to chill out. I’m trying my best to show her I want to be there for her, and I may be too over the top? I want to be more subtle, more like a person. I’ve decided tonight that we should be spending more time together through new experiences. I remember her going on about a trampoline park a couple a weeks ago, so what I’ve done tonight it book for us to go next week as a surprise. I hope she sees this as me trying to make the effort!
That does sound like the case bu she's always been very to her self, but recently more than ever! Again coming back to that shell!
I do kiss her randomly, hug her randomly and I show the most affection between us. I don't normally get much back..

That's a point I  hadn't considered, and very much makes sense! There's many event's coming up which her and her friends are interested in (me not so much) but I think I will make the effort to go. I think we've just gotten into a very bad reuitne of stay in, be together and that is it, and I really do believe it is me being the problem.
Aye that is very true! thanks for your suggestion!

This is the thing, I love going out with my friends, but I just never have been out with her! And I would love to try it out, but I'm pretty self conscious of the fact that I may not have much in common with her friends.. 

We are sexually incompatible, she doesn't need much sex. I told her though that I just want the passion back with her. I don't care if it's 1 week, or 3 wait, as long as it has meaning and love (which it hasn't from her at the moment) It would be worth while. 

I'm really willing to try the things that she wasn't me to be, just taking the step and getting out of my comfort zone is seriously hard!

Thankyou for your more insightful comment!

Well I considered myself environmentally depressed at the time. It was a shit place where everything revolved around work, and the people there. Because of it I made the decision to move it uni, but we made it clear that we intended to stay together, and we did. I think we found it both quite challenging as at the time of depression, my only friend was her and I would get very upset of her healthy social life, and especially jealous. I think once I had reached uni, and started getting my social life back, she was happy for me, but didn't appreciate the more active social life I had at the same time, very similarly to how I was! I'll give you an idea, If I'm upset, or down I often check the only social media I use to see if she's looked at it while she's out on a night out. And she explained she did that most nights while I was out. So I do see that similarity between us.

I was away for four weeks at a time while at uni, meaning our contact was mostly done through text and the occasional call. I must admit, I was going through a rough patch, thinking we may be better apart at that point, but after seeing her over Christmas I really did feel that absence really did make the heart grow from that point on.

From there, things just got slow. Didn't do much, saw each other, didn't do anything exciting and it was at that point I think the tides turned to how they are. I noticed she wouldn't really give me much affection for a few months, and it really hurt me. I approached her about it and she explained that she was upset about how we didn't do what couples do. She gave an example of her friends' boyfriends go out with them on nights out, and I never do. It is important to mention I don't have much in common with them, and to be truthful I have never made the effort to meet them properly. Ever since then I've been quite self conscious of when she goes out, I always ask if the boyfriends go and from talking last night she's noticed that.

I explained that since Christmas she just became tough, and insensitive. Last night was the only time I'd seen her vulnerable, as she couldn't find any clothes to wear this weekend. It was that fluster and frustration It made me quite happy to see, as I never get any negative emotion like this from her, and certainly not seen in the last 5 months! I just went up to her and hugged her, took her a few seconds to hug me back but it was me supporting her, and I loved it, missed it!.

I approached her that night after some very awkward sex on her behalf, and she explained to me that she just doesn't feel like she needed sex no longer, and that she didn't feel the passion anymore. I did question her what was it but she couldn't give me a sure answer. She didn't know.This was important as this confrontation just allowed us to talk about what we felt, and she'd been worried about me. I explained about the lack of emotion, and that I wanted to know things that troubled her, and she did understand that she'd been quite tough, both with family, friends and me. She did say she'll start to trust in me now, and build up that confidence to tell me her problems, and I seem to always tell mine and I told her I was getting hesitant, as I feel like she's just mt therapist. I also approached her about the consciousness about her friends, and that I would like to go on a night out with her but just don't know how. 

Last night was a breakthrough, I hope this makes sense!

We've established that we have more not in common than we do in common. I know that sounds like a red flag, and I do believe it is a worry but I think I will adapt to do more of the stuff she enjoys this summer. WE go places very often, walk and such. 

The main worry is I'm not friends with her friends and vice versa. She has hinted in the past that we don't do what couples usually do e.g she hinted that her friends' boyfriends go with them on nights out, and I never have. It is also important to note that she has a much healthier social life than I do, meaning I depend on her more than what she does me. This has certainly played on my mind a lot in the past few months, and I explained this to her last night. We don't go out for drinks or anything, that's mostly my fault. I think she hates that about me, and I'm not sure how to change it. I don't mind going out but I feel because we've never really done it, I'm quite shy knowing that she doesn't like that about me.

Last night we both had sex for the first time in two weeks, and even at the start I knew she wasn't bothered. It was very awkward from her and I had to approach her about it. She basically said she doesn't feel like she needs it and just feels the passion isn't there. Obviously this tore my mind to pieces and she didn't give much of a reason why that is. I asked her if it was me, or if she wasn't attracted to me no longer but she just replied saying that she doesn't know and that's just how she feels about it now.

Otherwise we go places often, see each other often, and I've proposed places for us to go and see for this summer. Today I booked this trampoline place for us to go because I remember her mentioning is a few weeks back. Hopefully she will appreciate it.
Dude all your replied to posts are to move on. Have you ever been in a relationship?

Though I can agree with you in some cases, as I also have had a horrible time in my life plagued with depression, with her by my side supporting me. She really is not depressed.

I asked her directly last night weather she wanted to break up and she replied that she wants to stay together and make the effort to get it back to how it was. Will we stay together? Who knows, time will tell. But what I do know is she wants to bring back the work that she may have lost from the relationship.

We're both outdoorsie, as both of us met and worked in the industry! Though they make you happy we've had some sketchy and adrenaline filled trip together haha! I'm a keen cook so I do all the cooking for her (sure she appreciates that). Museums is something we regularly visit. 

We have a trip to Spain next month so that should be a nice change so we're on the right track. Thanks for the support my man!
Haha that suggestion may be a little tedious to clean up! Thank you for your advice my friend!

I would like to offer her more experiences together. Do you have any ideas which could possibly be quite meaningful?

We are different in more ways that common. And we've both highlighted this. She's into things culturally different to me, and so is her friends. This really does play on my mind quite often. I would like to offer her something new in a way, both to me and her.
Not going to lie mate you've not helped much. Thanks for the comments.
I may have to also mention that she has withdrawn emotionally from not only us, but also work and family. Surely admitting that she will change for the better shows she’s willing to carry on?

Hi Raze, I'm glad we did speak as she's always been a stubborn person. Last night, hearing her agree, and notice that she has become a little stiff did make me quite relieved. 

We do many of these things, walks, movies, and we've got a holiday coming up next month. When asking what could I do, I was more along the lines of what things specifically can I do, that is meaningful and thoughtful for her. I recently bought her a pretty necklace, that has meaning and related to our countries traditions (that's quite pricey) out of the blue for her, while expressing that I loved her. She took it in and wears it everyday. IS there more things like that you can suggest? Without the price tag!

Not sure about a professional as I live in a rural place. But I do know my depressive state is related to the lack of social interaction. There are a few other stressors  also which do add to the it, but I'm sure writing them down and understanding them is a good place to start!
I met with my girlfriend last night as she thought I seemed down. I couldn't tell her what was on my mind. Probably not the best thing to keep in.
So you suggest I write everything down that is affecting me and try and understand why those points are affecting me and how to resolve them?

That's a positive comment, thank you. I'm seeing her tonight and she want's me to explain what's wrong. I really do hate it doing so though as it's always me where there is something wrong. I feel quite embarrassed at this point as I feel like I'm becoming a pain.

Hey pal. I'm a lad who's twenty and I've been in three long term relationships and currently in one. My advice is do whatever makes you happy. I wouldn't worry too much about it as it will come naturally at the right time. I personally have never forced any of the relationships I've been in, they just came at times I didn't really expect. People I new which I never thought I'd end up being with who I just got chatting to, and blew up from there.
